channel.title: Evostackr — Engineering Blog & Product Blueprints
channel.description: Authoritative engineering guides, multi-agent AI architecture blueprints, Google Play Closed Testing playbooks, and SaaS system designs from Evostackr.

item.title: Enterprise Agentic AI Architecture: Production Blueprint for Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems
item.description: Explore the complete production blueprint for enterprise agentic AI systems. Learn how multi-agent topologies, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool execution, and deterministic evaluation loops transform stochastic LLMs into resilient autonomous workflows.

item.title: Modern Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture: Isolation Models, Database Strategies, and Scalability
item.description: Compare Silo, Pool, and Bridge multi-tenancy models. Learn how to architect database partitioning strategies, implement PostgreSQL Row-Level Security, and prevent noisy-neighbor performance degradation in high-growth enterprise SaaS platforms.

item.title: Microservices Design Patterns: Architectural Blueprint for Resilient Distributed Systems
item.description: Discover the essential design patterns for building fault-tolerant microservices. From domain decomposition and the Saga pattern to API gateways, circuit breakers, and distributed tracing, learn how to prevent cascading failures across cloud services.

item.title: Google Play Closed Testing in 2026: The Complete Guide to the 14-Day Tester Requirement
item.description: Navigate Google Play’s strict 2026 closed testing policy for personal developer accounts. Learn exact tester recruitment criteria, 14-day opt-in verification rules, production application review guidelines, and how to avoid outright account rejections.

item.title: Cloud-Native DevOps CI/CD: Building Zero-Downtime Deployment Pipelines with Kubernetes
item.description: Design resilient zero-downtime deployment pipelines for cloud-native software. Master automated unit/integration testing gates, immutable container tagging, ArgoCD GitOps reconciliation, and Kubernetes canary traffic shifting.

item.title: Enterprise API Integration Patterns: Architecting Resilient Webhooks and Event Synchronization
item.description: Master enterprise API integration patterns for mission-critical software. Learn how to architect asynchronous webhook ingestion pipelines, enforce cryptographic HMAC signature verification, guarantee idempotency with Redis keys, and manage dead-letter replays.

item.title: Component-Driven Development: Architecting Scalable Design Systems from Atoms to Applications
item.description: Transform your frontend engineering workflow with Component-Driven Development (CDD). Learn how to structure design token taxonomies, isolate presentation from business logic, enforce strict UI geometry invariants, and accelerate delivery using automated UI builders like Fabricate.

item.title: High-Throughput Messaging Infrastructure: Designing Reliable Bulk Delivery Systems
item.description: Explore the internal architecture of high-throughput messaging platforms. Learn how to interface with SMPP carrier links, partition distributed queues with Kafka and Redis, handle regulatory DND compliance, and process millions of delivery receipts asynchronously.
